tickets.name: First Points
tickets.note: Hawks roll into Wizards territory, and the first minute is all we care about! It starts with Davis against Okongwu at center court, and our money says Davis gets up there first! So the Wizards should get the first crack at it. Dybantsa is the first option in that opening set, and he does not pass it up! And if the Hawks flip the script, Okongwu is waiting right there to pounce! Every one of our picks is a way to win the opening bucket, and every one of them cashes!

Collins is right behind him, ready to pounce on any mistake! Pick your poison, because any of them covers it!
